mapper.sql: id, ${admin.userId} AS user_id, state, created_at, last_activity_at, absolute_expires_at, mfa_verified_at, step_up_at, mfa_failed_attempts, host(ip) AS ip, user_agent
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${admin.sessions} (id, ${admin.userId}, token_hash, state, created_at, last_activity_at, absolute_expires_at, mfa_verified_at, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{state}, #{now}, #{now}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, #{mfaVerifiedAt}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ${admin.sessions} WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ${admin.sessions} SET last_activity_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND last_activity_at < #{threshold}
mapper.select: UPDATE ${admin.sessions} SET mfa_failed_attempts = mfa_failed_attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId} RETURNING mfa_failed_attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE ${admin.sessions} SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
